Etherisc is a decentralized insurance platform built on the Ethereum blockchain. Etherisc provides a framework for developing and operating insurance products through smart contracts. Etherisc operates without a central insurance intermediary that controls the underlying contracts.

Bridge Mutual is a decentralized insurance protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Bridge Mutual offers cover against smart contract failures. Bridge Mutual is funded by liquidity providers who deposit capital into pools that back the insurance cover.

Liquity is a decentralized borrowing protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Liquity lets users borrow the LUSD stablecoin against Ether used as collateral. Liquity charges a one-time borrowing fee rather than ongoing interest on loans. Liquity is operated through smart contracts without a central intermediary.

Convex is a yield optimization protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Convex works with Curve Finance by accepting Curve liquidity provider tokens and staking them on behalf of users. Convex issues its own CVX token to participants and uses its position in Curve governance to boost rewards for depositors.

Terra-Luna ecosystem is a blockchain ecosystem built on a proof-of-stake public blockchain. Terra-Luna ecosystem centers on the algorithmic stablecoin TerraUSD, which is designed to maintain a peg to the US dollar. Terra-Luna ecosystem uses the LUNA token as a companion asset that absorbs stablecoin supply changes through minting and burning. Terra-Luna ecosystem experienced a sharp collapse of the UST peg and the LUNA price in May 2022.
